title: Drop Tool with Q
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local function dropIstupiditem(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if tool then
            tool.Parent = game.Workspace
            tool.Position = character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
        end
    end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then -- Keybind
        local player = Players.LocalPlayer
        dropIstupiditem(player)
    end
end)
